entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is 944-118-B.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order... I see it's for the Velo-Carbon cycling shoes. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue?
They don't work for me. I just want to know if I can return them or not.
I understand you want a quick answer. Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue? This helps me process it correctly.
Look, I've tried. I adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but the fit is just wrong. I went for one long ride and they gave me terrible blisters. I need to send them back and get a refund.
I'm sorry to hear that, getting blisters is no fun. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, I see you received them 77 days ago.

Yes, absolutely. Our policy covers returns for up to 90 days, so you are well within the window. I've just initiated the return process for your cycling shoes and the pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email right now.
Okay. Good. That's all I needed.
Perfect. Once our warehouse receives the return, the refund will be processed back to your original form of payment. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
